items.title: Public Meetings to Consider Zoning Amendments
RZ016/22 - Zoning By-law Amendment re: 7197 Wellington Road 21,
notes: Pilkington

Deputy Mayor Jefferson indicated the purpose of the public meeting is to present and receive public input regarding a proposed zoning by-law amendment on subject lands known as 7197 Wellington Road 21, former Township of Pilkington.

She explained the zoning by-law amendment proposes to change the zoning of the subject land from “A” Agriculture and “EP” Environmental Protection to “A” Agriculture Exception and “EP” Environmental Protection. The effect of the proposed Zoning By-law Amendment is to implement zoning regulations necessary to facilitate a farm dwelling surplus severance by restricting residential uses on the retained parcel.
The zoning amendment is a condition of approval of the County of Wellington Land Division Committee Application B92-22.

Deputy Mayor Jefferson stated if a person or public body does not make oral submissions at the public meeting, or make written submissions to the Township of Centre Wellington before the by-law is passed, the person or public body is not entitled to appeal the decision of the Township of Centre Wellington to the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT).

She further noted if a person or public body does not make oral submission at the public meeting, or make written submissions to the Township of Centre Wellington before the by-law is passed, the person or public body may not be added as the party to the hearing of an appeal before the Ontario Land Tribunal unless, in the opinion of the Tribunal, there are reasonable grounds to do so.

She indicated if anyone wishes to be notified of the adoption of the proposed zoning by-law amendment, a written request must be filed with the Municipal Clerk, Township of Centre Wellington, 1 MacDonald Square, Elora, ON N0B 1S0.

Deputy Mayor Jefferson asked the Deputy Municipal Clerk to indicate how notice of the public meeting was given. The Deputy Municipal Clerk indicated notice was mailed to prescribed persons, agencies and public bodies on or before December 22, 2022 and a copy of the notice was placed in the Wellington Advertiser on December 22, 2022.
The Deputy Municipal Clerk confirmed the requirement for giving notice was completed on December 22, 2022.
Deputy Mayor Jefferson called on Mariana Iglesias, Senior Planner, to introduce the application.

M. Iglesias indicated the rezoning application is for the property located at 7197 Wellington Road 21, on the west side of Sixth Line East, in the former Township of Pilkington. The subject land currently supports an active farming operation and residential dwelling.

She explained the rezoning application seeks to rezone the 26 ha retained farm parcel from Agricultural and Environmental Protection to add an exception to the Agricultural zoning to prohibit residential uses as required by Provincial and County policies for farm dwelling surplus resulting in no new dwelling being constructed on the farm land. The severed parcel with the dwelling would otherwise meet all the applicable zoning regulations for size and setbacks. The associated severance was conditionally approved by the County of Wellington through consent application B92/22.

She further indicated no oral or written submissions were received from the public to date and the County of Wellington and Grand River Conservation Authority commented on the application with no objections to the rezoning.

Deputy Mayor Jefferson called on Jeff Buisman, VanHarten Surveying, agent for the applicant, who indicated this is a surplus farm severance with one unique element for an easement for the existing gas line.
Mike Nagy, resident confirmed this rezoning application will not permit a new subdivision and confirmed no change to the environmental protection.
Deputy Mayor Jefferson seeing no further delegations and no questions from Council declared the meeting adjourned.

items.title: RZ018/22 Zoning By-law Amendment re: 7158 Third Line, West
notes: Garafraxa

Deputy Mayor Jefferson indicated the purpose of this public meeting is to present and receive public input regarding a proposed zoning by-law amendment on subject lands known as 7158 Third Line, former Township of West Garafraxa.

She explained the purpose of the proposed Zoning By-law Amendment is to change the current zoning “A” Agriculture to “A” Agriculture Exception, and to permit a reduced rear yard setback from the existing barn on the severed parcel to be 5.0 m instead of the required 18 m. The effect of the proposed Zoning By-law Amendment is to implement zoning regulations necessary to facilitate a farm dwelling surplus severance by restricting residential uses on the retained parcel. The zoning amendment is a condition of approval of the County of Wellington Land Division Committee Application B74-22.

Deputy Mayor Jefferson stated if a person or public body does not make oral submissions at the public meeting, or make written submissions to the Township of Centre Wellington before the by-law is passed, the person or public body is not entitled to appeal the decision of the Township of Centre Wellington to the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT).

She further noted if a person or public body does not make oral submission at the public meeting, or make written submissions to the Township of Centre Wellington before the by-law is passed, the person or public body may not be added as the party to the hearing of an appeal before the Ontario Land Tribunal unless, in the opinion of the Tribunal, there are reasonable grounds to do so.

She indicated if anyone wishes to be notified of the adoption of the proposed zoning by-law amendment, a written request must be filed with the Municipal Clerk, Township of Centre Wellington, 1 MacDonald Square, Elora, ON N0B 1S0.

Deputy Mayor Jefferson asked the Deputy Municipal Clerk to indicate how notice of the public meeting was given. The Deputy Municipal Clerk indicated notice was mailed to prescribed persons, agencies and public bodies on or before December 22, 2022 and a copy of the notice was placed in the Wellington Advertiser on December 22, 2022.
The Deputy Municipal Clerk confirmed the requirement for giving notice was completed on December 22, 2022.
Deputy Mayor Jefferson called on Mariana Iglesias, Senior Planner to introduce the application.

Mariana Iglesias, Senior Planner outlined the rezoning application for the property located at 7158 Third Line, east of Sideroad 25, in the former Township of West Garafraxa. She indicated the property currently supports an active farming operation and residential dwelling.

She explained the rezoning application seeks to rezone the 33 ha retained farm parcel from Agricultural to add an exception to prohibit residential uses as required by Provincial and County policies for farm dwelling surplus severances that are related to farm consolidation, so a new dwelling cannot be constructed on the farm land. The severed parcel with the dwelling and barn also requires an exception to the zoning to recognize a reduced rear yard setback for the barn. The parcel will otherwise meet all the applicable zoning regulations.

She further indicated no oral or written submissions were received from the public for this application to date and the County of Wellington and Grand River Conservation Authority commented on the application with no objections to the rezoning.
Deputy Mayor Jefferson called on Jeff Buisman, VanHarten Surveying.

Jeff Buisman, VanHarten Surveying, agent for the applicant, indicated there is currently an argi business operating on the retained parcel of land and the intention is the business will continue on the retained parcel.
Seeing no delegations, Deputy Mayor Jefferson asked if there are any questions from Council.
In response to questions from Council, staff indicated a nutrient management plan has been submitted and clarified the business is an existing business not a new use.
Deputy Mayor Jefferson declared the meeting adjourned.

items.title: Workshop - Land Use Planning 101, The Tools in the Toolbox
notes: Murray Clarke, Erebus Municipal Services Inc.

Murray Clarke, Erebus Municipal Services Inc., gave a presentation outlining the different elements of land use planning including, Provincial Policy Statements, Official Plans, Zoning By-laws, Community Improvement Plans, Plans of Subdivision, Land Severance, site plan control, minor variance, Committee of Adjustments, and the role of the Ontario Land Tribunal. He further reviewed the advances in the Province’s agenda for housing, the effects of Bill 23 and the Minister Zoning Orders.
Council Recessed from 4:05pm to 4:27pm.
Deputy Mayor Jefferson indicated the presenters and delegations had been asked to arrive for 5:00 pm and indicated Council will move to Consideration of Reports, 2023 CW Neighbourhood Grant.

items.title: 2023 CW Neighbourhood Grant
notes: Report from K. Martin, Communications and Strategic Initiatives Specialist

K. Martin, Communications and Strategic Initiatives Specialist responded to questions from Council regarding how the program started, clarified the resources required to administer the grant program and explained the selection process.
D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer indicated this proposal is a continuation of the pilot program in 2022 and would be incorporated into the 2024 budget with Council’s direction.
